definitions.explanation: A long needle used for knitting, usually in pairs. From {編|あ}む (to knit) plus {針|はり} (needle).

examples.japanese: {編|あ}み{針|ばり}でマフラーを{編|あ}む。
examples.english: To knit a scarf with knitting needles.

examples.japanese: {毛糸|けいと}と{編|あ}み{針|ばり}を{買|か}ってきた。
examples.english: I bought yarn and knitting needles.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{編|あ}み{針|ばり}を{動|うご}かしながら{昔|むかし}の{話|はなし}をしてくれた。
examples.english: My grandmother told old stories while working her knitting needles.

notes:
From {編|あ}む (to knit) plus {針|はり} (needle); the は voices to ば in the compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {編|あ}み{針|ばり}で{編|あ}む: to knit with needles
- {棒針|ぼうばり}: straight knitting needle
- かぎ{針|ばり}: crochet hook

RELATED WORDS:
- {縫|ぬ}い{針|ばり}: sewing needle
- {毛糸|けいと}: knitting yarn
